tasks.gr11-careers-career-choices-t4: Topic: Careers and Career Choices. Cover the range of post-school pathways (university, TVET, learnerships, workplace training), bursary and financial aid options, skills development programmes, and how to match personal strengths to career fields. Ask Grade 11 learners to compare two post-school pathways, identify entry requirements for a specific career, research a bursary or funding opportunity, or map their strengths to potential careers.
tasks.gr11-world-of-work-entrepreneurship-t4: Topic: World of Work and Entrepreneurship. Cover professional work ethics and workplace norms, the labour market in South Africa including unemployment trends, the difference between employment and entrepreneurship, and characteristics of a successful entrepreneur. Ask Grade 11 learners to analyse a workplace scenario using work ethics principles, evaluate entrepreneurial opportunities, describe labour market challenges, or explain how entrepreneurship can address unemployment.
tasks.gr11-application-documents-planning-t4: Topic: Application Documents and Planning. Cover the conventions of a formal application letter, the structure and purpose of a Curriculum Vitae (CV), the role of references and portfolios, and how to present oneself in a mock interview. Ask Grade 11 learners to draft or correct an application letter, identify errors in a sample CV, describe what to include in a portfolio, or prepare responses to common interview questions.
tasks.gr11-physical-education-task-4-t4: Topic: Physical Education Task — Term 4. Cover reviewing personal fitness progress over the year, the importance of lifelong physical activity for health, setting sustainable physical activity goals for the future, and evaluating participation habits. Ask Grade 11 learners to complete a fitness reflection, set SMART activity goals for Grade 12 or post-school life, analyse their participation record, or explain why lifelong activity matters for wellbeing.
